'''Red Patrol''' was a patrol unit of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] that was present on the ''[[Ascendant Spear]]'' whilst [[Theron Shan]] undertook a mission on the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]]. The patrol reported that C Deck was clear and that they were about to head to F Deck.<ref name="Annihilation" />
